title: Sticky Hold on Active Connection (<130ms)
setup: Active=Eth1 (90ms), Eth2=50ms, Eth3=110ms, Threshold=130ms
expected: Retain Eth1 to prevent game micro-stutter/disconnect
actual: Held on eth1 (90ms) despite eth2 having 50ms (Zero packet loss / no connection restart)

title: Near-Boundary Ping Below Threshold (129ms)
setup: Active=Eth1 (129ms), Eth2=60ms, Eth3=80ms
expected: Retain Eth1 (129ms <= 130ms)
actual: Held on eth1 at 129.0ms (< 130.0ms threshold)

title: Threshold Breached by 1ms (131ms)
setup: Active=Eth1 (131ms), Eth2=70ms, Eth3=110ms
expected: Switch to Eth2 (lowest RTT)
actual: Switched to eth2 (70ms) because eth1 exceeded 130ms threshold (131.0ms)

title: Exact Threshold Boundary (130.0ms)
setup: Active=Eth1 (130.0ms), Eth2=60ms
expected: Retain Eth1 (130.0ms <= 130ms)
actual: Held on eth1 at exactly 130.0ms (<= condition satisfied)

title: Gamer Prompt Case: Active=145ms vs Eth1=90ms
setup: Active=Eth2 (145ms), Eth1=90ms, Eth3=160ms
expected: Immediate switch to Eth1 (90ms), then sticky lock on Eth1
actual: Switched from eth2 (145ms) to eth1 (90ms), then locked onto eth1

title: All Links in Degraded State (>130ms)
setup: Active=Eth1 (190ms), Eth2=170ms, Eth3=140ms
expected: Switch to best-effort lowest RTT (Eth3 at 140ms)
actual: Switched to lowest available degraded link: eth3 (140ms)

title: Active Primary Cable Pulled (1-Link Failure)
setup: Active=Eth1 (75ms) goes DOWN. Eth2=85ms, Eth3=110ms remain UP
expected: Instant failover to Eth2 (85ms)
actual: Instant failover to eth2 (85ms) when eth1 broke

title: Double Simultaneous Failure (2 of 3 Links Die)
setup: Eth1 and Eth2 go DOWN simultaneously. Only Eth3 UP (95ms)
expected: Instant rescue to Eth3
actual: Rescued game connection on eth3 (95ms)

title: Secondary Cable Disconnect (Non-Active Line Fails)
setup: Active=Eth1 (90ms) UP, Eth2 disconnected
expected: Zero disturbance to active session on Eth1
actual: Eth1 completely unaffected and game continues with 0 dropped frames

title: Catastrophic Failure (All 3 Links Down)
setup: Eth1=DOWN, Eth2=DOWN, Eth3=DOWN
expected: Returns None cleanly without crash or infinite recursion
actual: Gracefully detected all lines down (returns None, triggers offline alert)

title: Silent ISP Freeze (Probe Timeout on Active Line)
setup: Eth1 link stays connected in Windows, but probe to Azure fails
expected: Failover to healthy Eth2
actual: Successfully switched to eth2 after probe failure detection

title: Primary Recovers with God-Tier Ping while Gaming
setup: Active=Eth2 (85ms). Eth1 recovers with 35ms
expected: Do NOT preemptively switch. Stay on Eth2 to avoid match DC
actual: Anti-flapping active: stay on eth2 (85ms <= 130ms) despite eth1 (35ms) recovering

title: Primary Recovers while Active Line is Lagging (>130ms)
setup: Active=Eth2 (145ms > 130ms). Eth1 recovers with 40ms
expected: Immediate switch to Eth1 (40ms)
actual: Successfully pre-empted lagging eth2 (145ms) for recovering eth1 (40ms)

title: Rapid Flapping Stress Test (20 Flap Cycles)
setup: Eth1 repeatedly disconnects and reconnects every cycle
expected: Engine stabilizes on Eth2 without bouncing back and forth
actual: 20/20 flapping cycles survived: game locked securely to eth2 without jitter

title: Gradual Bufferbloat Progression (90ms -> 134ms)
setup: Eth1 latency slowly rises under download load until breaching 130ms
expected: Hold until 130ms breached, then cleanly switch to Eth2
actual: Held through gradual rise up to 129ms, escaped to eth2 at 134ms

title: Transient Ping Spike Recovery (No Double-Hop)
setup: Eth1 spikes to 280ms, switches to Eth2 (100ms), then Eth1 returns to 90ms
expected: Stay locked on Eth2 (avoid double hop that kills game connection)
actual: Escaped 280ms spike to eth2; locked stably on eth2 after spike subsided

title: Regional ISP Route Asymmetry (Azure India vs SE Asia)
setup: Eth1 route to Pune=88ms, SG=148ms. Eth2 route to Pune=135ms, SG=92ms
expected: Optimal NIC chosen per target region based on 130ms threshold
actual: Correctly picked Eth1 (88ms) for Azure India, and Eth2 (92ms) for Azure Singapore

title: Force Override with Dead-Link Fallback
setup: Gamer manually forces Eth3. Then Eth3 experiences link failure
expected: Bypass sticky to force Eth3, then failover to best healthy link on death
actual: Forced Eth3 honored (115ms), and gracefully fell back to eth1 when Eth3 died

title: 10,000-Iteration High Frequency Sticky Evaluation Stress
setup: Evaluate preferred_uplink() 10,000 times under continuous active state
expected: Rock-solid consistency, zero drift, > 50,000 ops/sec
actual: 10,000 routing evaluations in 39.4ms (253,802 ops/sec, 0 lock contention)

title: Multi-Threaded Concurrency Stress (8 Threads, 4,000 Operations)
setup: 8 worker threads querying and updating probe states simultaneously
expected: Thread-safe execution without race conditions or deadlocks
actual: 8 concurrent threads, 4,000 cross-thread evaluations completed with 0 errors

title: RuleEngine Deep Matching & Dynamic CRUD Validation
setup: Test process matching with full paths, case-insensitivity, and dynamic CRUD
expected: Deterministic routing match for AoE4 and background apps
actual: All process rules, path parsing, accounting, and dynamic CRUD verified

title: Throughput Monitor Math & Delta Calculations
setup: Feed controlled NIC counter samples to verify bit-rate calculations
expected: Exact bit-rate computation with zero precision loss
actual: Throughput calculated accurately: RX=80.0 Mbps, TX=40.0 Mbps

title: SourcePortPool Cyclic Isolation & Wrap-around
setup: Acquire ports through full range and test circular wrap-around
expected: Consistent wrap-around without out-of-range ports
actual: SourcePortPool smoothly cycled through 30000-30010 and wrapped to 30000
